etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin plasticus (“of molding”), from Ancient Greek πλαστικός (plastikós), from πλάσσω (plássō, “to mold, form”). Doublet of plastique.
senses: A synthetic, solid, hydrocarbon-based polymer, whether thermoplastic or thermosetting.
(colloquial, metonymic) Credit or debit cards used in place of cash to buy goods and services.
Capable of being moulded; malleable, flexible, pliant. [from 17th c.]
